page.overview:
Who is 8-Head Ted?

8-Head Ted is a character seen in the Issue 20 of the Adventure Time comic line. As his name implies, he has 8 heads. According to the comic, "Only one of his heads is evil: the other 7 are pretty chill actually".

Seven of the heads have blonde hair, and one has dark green hair; the one with dark green hair is clearly the evil one because it has pointed ears, a frowning red mouth, and two red eyes. The rest of the heads are all blonde, but one is slightly balding, one has a mustache, and one has a mullet under a red baseball cap. The 8 heads connect into one body which is wearing a yellow tie, a white shirt, and a blue coat.
